title: The Valley That Woke Up
old_p1: Heavenly Father showed Ezekiel a vision, a picture from Heavenly Father. He saw a wide valley full of very dry bones. Heavenly Father led Ezekiel all around them. Everything was very still and quiet.
“Can these bones live again?” Heavenly Father asked. Ezekiel answered, “Heavenly Father, You know.” Heavenly Father told him, “Speak my words to them.”
old_p2: Ezekiel spoke, and there was a noise and a shaking. The bones came together, and people formed. Then breath came into them. They stood up alive, as many as a great army!
This vision taught Ezekiel’s sad people that Heavenly Father could bring them home again. It also reminds us that, because of Jesus, everyone will live again one day.
Heavenly Father can make new things grow. Tonight, breathe in slowly and feel the gift of your own breath.
p1: The prophet Ezekiel had a vision, a picture from Heavenly Father. He was in a valley full of very old, dry bones. All was still.
Heavenly Father asked, “Can these bones live?” Ezekiel answered, “Only You know.”
Heavenly Father told Ezekiel to speak His words, and he did. There was a noise and a shaking, and the bones came together. Then breath came into them, and they stood up, alive! So many people!
p2: Why this vision? His people were far from home. They felt their hope had dried up, like old bones. It showed Heavenly Father could bring them home and give new life. Because of Jesus, everyone will live again one day too.
Breath is a gift from Heavenly Father. Tonight, take a slow, deep breath in and out. Say thank you for it.
